mapper.select:
select id , api_code , src_path as srcPath , target_path as targetPath , type as type , data_type as dataType , suffix as suffix , is_unzip as isUnzip , unzip_filename_charset as unzipFilenameCharset , src_sftp_host as srcSftpHost , src_sftp_port as srcSftpPort , src_sftp_user as srcSftpUser , src_sftp_pwd as srcSftpPwd , target_sftp_host as targetSftpHost , target_sftp_port as targetSftpPort , target_sftp_user as targetSftpUser , target_sftp_pwd as targetSftpPwd , src_type as srcType , target_type as targetType , execute_time as executeTime from b_sync_config sc
status = 1
and api_code like CONCAT('%', #{apiCode}, '%')
and data_type = #{dataType}
order by create_time desc
